    • store

      public McpClientRegistrationManager.Builder store(McpClientRegistrationStore value)
      Sets the optional issuer-keyed credential store. When omitted, the manager runs in on-demand mode and performs a fresh DCR on every resolve(...) call (compliant per Q8).
      Parameters:
      value - The store. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • registrarFunction

      public McpClientRegistrationManager.Builder registrarFunction(Function<OidcMetadata,McpClientRegistration> value)
      Overrides the registration function the manager invokes to perform DCR (advanced / test seam).

      The default builds an McpDynamicClientRegistrar from the discovered OidcMetadata and performs a live RFC 7591 round-trip; supply this to inject an alternate registration strategy or a stub.

      Parameters:
      value - The registration function mapping a discovered AS to an issued McpClientRegistration. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This object.
